plain.li: [land:desert] Founding day. {A_nameDef} has filled a jar with sand from where the first tent stood, which is how the day begins here now.
[land:tundra] Founding day, and {A_nameDef} has been telling the young ones how cold the first night was. Colder than this, apparently. It is always colder than this.
[land:coast] Founding day. {A_nameDef} went down to the shore at dawn, where the colony first came ashore, and walked back up the way they came.
[land:forest|land:boreal] Founding day. {A_nameDef} has tied a ribbon round the stump of the first tree the colony felled; it's still there by the gate.
[land:mountains|land:hills] Founding day. {A_nameDef} climbed to the ledge where the first lookout stood, and waved down at everyone.
[land:swamp|land:jungle] Founding day. {A_nameDef} says nobody slept the first night for the insects, and everyone laughs because it's still true.
[land:river] Founding day. {A_nameDef} set a little boat of bark on the river at dawn, the way the colony counts its years.
[faith] Founding day. {A_nameDef} gave thanks at first light for the colony and everyone in it, and wants the day kept well.
[devout] Founding day. {A_nameDef} spent the dawn at prayer for the ones who founded this place, the living and the dead.
[land:desert] Harvest day. Every green thing in the {PLACE} is hard won, and {A_nameDef} wants the first sheaf on the table where everyone can see it.
[land:tundra] Harvest day. In a land this cold a harvest at all is a small wonder, and {A_nameDef} says so to anyone who'll listen.
[land:jungle|land:swamp] Harvest day. {A_nameDef} has hung the first of the crop over the door before the damp can get at it.
[land:river] Harvest day. {A_nameDef} says the river gave the colony its first crop, and has thrown a handful of grain into it by way of thanks.
[devout] Harvest day. {A_nameDef} set the first of the grain at the altar before anyone ate.
[land:desert] Snow in the {PLACE}: rare enough here that {A_nameDef} is out in it with both hands held up, laughing.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] The first snow, which here means the long white has truly begun. {A_nameDef} has the games ready anyway.
[land:mountains] The first snow came down off the peaks overnight. {A_nameDef} watched it come, line by line, down the slopes.
[land:coast|land:lake] {NAME}, and {A_nameDef} wants the feast down by the water, with whatever the water gave this week.
[land:desert] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} has set the tables in the shade, with a water jar at every place.
[faith] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} will say the faith's blessing before the feast, as it's always said.
[devout] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} has kept a lamp lit at the altar since dawn, and asks that everyone keep a quiet hour.
[faith] {NAME}, and {A_nameDef} has the faith's words for the dead ready for this evening.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} cleared the snow from every stone at dawn.
[land:desert] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} poured a cup of water on the ground for the remembered, the way it's done here.
[devout] {A_nameDef} has kept a lamp burning at the altar since dawn for {DEAD}, who died on this day.
[faith] Today the colony remembers {DEAD}. {A_nameDef} will say the faith's words at the grave this evening.
[land:desert] Today the colony remembers {DEAD}. {A_nameDef} has poured water at the grave, the way it's done in the {PLACE}.
[land:coast] Today the colony remembers {DEAD}. {A_nameDef} went down to the shore at dawn and left a stone there for {DEAD}.
[land:desert] Founding day. I walked out to where the first tent stood. The sand has covered every trace, and we're still here.
[land:coast] Founding day. Walked the shore at dawn where we first came up. The sea doesn't remember us. We remember it.
[land:mountains|land:hills] Founding day. From the ledge the colony looks small, and like it belongs.
[land:tundra] Founding day. Another year the cold didn't win.
[devout] Founding day. I gave thanks for every year we've had here, and asked for one more.
[!new,land:desert] Harvest day. Every grain of it fought the sun for us.
[!new,land:tundra|land:boreal] Harvest day. Short summer, long winter, and still a harvest. I'll take it.
[!new,devout] Harvest day. The first grain went to the altar and the rest to the table.
[devout] I lit a lamp for {DEAD} today. I believe {DEAD} is kept, wherever that is.
[faith] Said the faith's words at {DEAD}'s grave. They helped more than I expected.
[devout] {NAME}. I prayed for them at the altar, and felt they heard.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] {NAME}. We cleared the snow from the stones together and said the names into the cold.
[land:coast] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} walked down to the shore where the colony first landed.
[land:desert] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} how the colony found its first water in the {PLACE}.
[land:forest|land:boreal] {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} the stump of the first tree the colony felled.
[land:river] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} watched the bark boats go down the river for founding day.
[devout] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} prayed together for the colony's dead on {NAME}.
[faith] {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} what the faith says becomes of the dead.
